notes.title: Christmas in Muffinski!
notes.content:
1.62 Full

Its Christmas time in Muffinski, you have been supplied the following office festival furniture.

 Added:

 - 1 Christmas Tree.
 - 1 Small Desk Snowman.

Who said Muffinski doesn't give?

The duck overlords noticed that their ducks are not spawning in different places around the office.
This patch addresses the issue and appeases the duck overlords.

- Fixed random duck spawn.

notes.title: 1.6 Duck Invasion update
notes.content:
1.6 Duck Invasion Update is here!

The rubber ducks have invaded Muffinski!  It is up to you to help stop their plan of world domination!

Added:

- Ducks will randomly appear in the office, however they are not there for long.  You have to find them and click on them.

- Four new achievements!

- A Quack sound.

- A new (bad) ending!

notes.title: 1.4 Now Live
notes.content:
Hello! The Office of Internal Affairs arent happy with some of the screen sizes.

Fixed:
- Some of the screen sizes.

This should now be in line with Muffinski laws.

notes.title: 1.3 Update!
notes.content:
Yes, as in accordance with the Glorious Leader, 1.3 is now live!

Updated Unity Engine,
Game phone now has more phone calls.

notes.title: Opps! Quick Fix!
notes.content:
Version: Full 1.2b

Whats changed?

- Forgot to activate Achievements in the last build, thats now fixed!

Egg on my face!

notes.title: First Patch!
notes.content:
Version: Full 1.2

Whats been changed?

- Re-arranged paperwork screen, made the Correct / Wrong notification viewable.

Whats been added?

- Hard Mode! Complete the game to unlock this!
- 5 More Achievements for you too find!

notes.title: Sergei and the Tax Return
notes.content:
Version: Full V1.1

Sergei and the Tax Return is now availble on Steam worldwide! 

Join the adventures of hapless Sergei as he tries to be the best delivery driver ever!

Whats new in this version:

- Balancing issues addressed

Whats to come?

- Sort out that cursor so you can tell if you can click something better.
- Add more music? We know you love "that" song...
- Idea for a hard mode... more to come.

Anyways, enjoy!

notes.title: Balancing Update
notes.content:
Version: beta0.950

Whats happened in Muffinski this time, well here we go:

- Balancing the game so it starts to get harder mid to late game, Rent increase etc.
- Added Visual cues if a player is right or wrong with paperwork.
- The amazing #1 song by Glorious Ladies Love Glorious Leader now added for your (un)enjoyment!

notes.title: Another Little Update
notes.content:
Version: beta0.900

Big number jump as not much left now!

Whats been added?

- Save and Load system.  Game auto saves at the end of each day, you'll have the option to continue from the main menu.

notes.title: All News Done
notes.content:
Version: beta0.600

Whats been fixed and added this time?

- All news stories now re-written.
- Hopefully got all the spelling and grammer errors.

Whats left?

- Robust save and load system
- A possibility of a song, with like singing and stuff, ive sort of backed myself into a corner with this one.

notes.title: A wee little one
notes.content:
No updated version here as no bugs were fixed, this small update address the following:

- Began the fixing of spelling / grammer errors.
- Rewritting the news pages to more complete.

As the player will get most of the information regarding story and game events from the News panel, I thought it would be worth fleshing this section out.

notes.title: Another Update
notes.content:
We are now at Version: beta0.500

Whats new?

Radio voices now added! (Thanks to wifey)

notes.title: A wee update
notes.content:
Current Version is now: beta0.300

Whats been fixed:

- Removed exploit that enabled player to do two jobs at the same time.
- Made sure all upgrades applied for all missions, not just those off the job board.

notes.title: Egg on my Face!
notes.content:
Well, 2nd update of the day.  I did say I fixed the game breaking bugs...

And then promptly found a game breaking bug AFTER the update, go me!

So, whats been fixed this time?

- The "Accept" button was missing from the Day 18 mission, thus stopping the story dead in its tracks.
- Shrunk the "PHONE RINGING" notification as it was blocking certain buttons.

Added:

- You now have version number top right of menu screen, you lucky people you!

All hail our glourious leader!

notes.title: First Beta
notes.content:
This build is the first Beta of the game.

By now, hopefully most of the game breaking bugs have been dealt with.

Whats this build?

- Game now set to Beta.
- Most Game breaking bugs flattened
- Random phone ring should be right amount of annoying.
- Achievements Working.

Whats left?

- Addition Polish
- Full plays required for whole game testing
- Voices need to be added.

We are on track, so yay! 

All Hail Our Glourious Leader!

notes.title: Office Update
notes.content:
The general look of the office has been updated, new assets added.

Some general bug fixing.

notes.title: Another little update.
notes.content:
Alpha version: 0.9

No real fixes, however all the newspaper pictures have been added in.

notes.title: Another tiny fix
notes.content:
This is alpha build 0.85:

Discovered a bug in the storyline while testing, figured it would be a really neat idea to get that one fixed early.

Added some more whiteboard quotes.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content:
The original build it was possible, with the right combo of upgrades early on to abuse the income system.
Hopefully this will put that to rest.

The music also loops now, so yay?
